project.name: Muirdrum
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict-boundary audit completed. The local HES listed-building import returned zero records and the local NRHE import retained three records. One possible prehistoric roundhouse has a defensible broad material-period date; the period-unassigned socketed stone and road bridge remain intact but map-hidden. Current OSM and named-provider checks found no qualifying See, Eat, completed trail, picnic site, dedicated public visitor car park or public toilet. Angus Council records confirm that restoration of the Fairy Steps right of way remains ongoing, so it is not published as a ready visitor trail. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A small A92-edge village with limited archaeological context but no verified visitor attraction, service cluster or currently complete destination trail. Nearby Panbride and Carnoustie value is not transferred into Muirdrum.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: There is no verified destination-scale dog visit. The Fairy Steps restoration remains ongoing, so it is not promoted as a dependable route.

townGuide.headline: A regional reference rather than a visitor stop
townGuide.intro: Muirdrum scores 34% and remains in the Angus selector but off the main town map. Its local archaeological records remain available in the heritage data without borrowing Panbride or Carnoustie attractions and facilities.
perfectFor: Recognising the village while travelling between Dundee, Carnoustie and Arbroath
townGuide.visitorMood: A compact roadside village whose interest is primarily local and documentary.
